videos.title: 580 - Pick the user before you prep the data
videos.description:
580 - You have to pick the consumer before you prep the data. A data agent that checks PDFs wants different instructions than Copilot or a self-service path. These tools still don't share one brain.

#copilot #dataagent #powerbi #fabric

videos.title: 580 - Even Microsoft is still figuring this out
videos.description:
580 - We're at the part of the episode where nobody fully knows, including Microsoft and Anthropic. The concepts are right. The hard part is where that metadata and those definitions actually live.

#microsoft #anthropic #metadata #ai

videos.title: 580 - Your Power BI model is physical data
videos.description:
580 - This week every Power BI semantic model looked physical. The file holds real data and produces real numbers. Pull the rows out, and the tables and measures left behind are the concept you thought you were designing.

#powerbi #semanticmodel #datamodeling #ai

videos.title: 580 - Two teams couldn't agree what a book was
videos.description:
580 - Two departments could not agree what a book was, or where it sat in the product tree. That fight has to end before any AI-ready project starts. Shared definitions are the floor under the metadata.

#metadata #datagovernance #businessdefinitions #ai

videos.title: 580 - Why did you choose this model?
videos.description:
580 - Ask why this model was chosen before you ask if it's deduped. The ground floor is a team with a real purpose and someone who owns the thing. Data quality is the next story up.

#datagovernance #semanticmodel #dataquality #ai

videos.title: 580 - Make the model clear for people first
videos.description:
580 - The semantic model is supposed to explain the data to the next person who opens it. We're shaky at that already. Get the tables trustworthy for people, and the AI output gets better on the same path.

#semanticmodel #powerbi #dataquality #ai

videos.title: 580 - Nobody's job is to do AI
videos.description:
580 - Nobody's job is to do AI. You wouldn't say your job is to do data either. Start with one pointed dataset, aimed at a real outcome, before anyone tries to boil the ocean.

#ai #businessintelligence #data #strategy

videos.title: 580 - People still beat AI at reading models
videos.description:
580 - Hand Tommy a messy semantic model and he will get there, after years of bridging business questions to the tables. The open question is what happens when that same model gets handed to an AI.

#semanticmodel #powerbi #ai #data

videos.title: 580 - Business has no game over screen
videos.description:
580 - Basketball ends and somebody gets called the winner. Business never gets that buzzer. There is no season where you play for three years and then walk off because the game is over.

#business #strategy #ai #competition

videos.title: When Leadership Builds Part 2 - Ep. 584
videos.description: ok, now that your leader has claude, what can you expect next?

videos.title: 580 - Wait for perfect data and you never ship
videos.description:
580 - Waiting for perfect data means you never start. The data is alive. Today the customers sit in Dynamics, and a strategy shift can move them to Salesforce before the cleanup is done.

#dataquality #dynamics #salesforce #analytics

videos.title: 580 - Has your company data ever been perfect?
videos.description:
580 - Has any company you've worked with ever had data that was 100% ready? In Power BI that target has always moved, because the business keeps changing. So how does data ever get ready for AI?

#dataquality #powerbi #ai #analytics

videos.title: 580 - AI-ready data is just good data
videos.description:
580 - James's definition of AI-ready data is accurate and full of business context, the kind of thing a model can interpret. Pull the new label off. It's the same standard we've talked about for 10 years.

#aiready #dataquality #analytics #datagovernance

videos.title: 580 - The new warehouse deployed with no data
videos.description:
580 - The new warehouse deployed. There's no data in it. Production can't be touched, and a full 10-year copy is overkill, so the real question is how much of a slice dev and QA actually need.

#datawarehouse #testdata #devops #dataengineering

videos.title: 580 - New Delta features stay private for months
videos.description:
580 - New Delta tricks stay inside Databricks for six to nine months before they hit the open spec. That window is the edge. Power BI and every other reader of those tables just waits.

#databricks #deltalake #powerbi #dataengineering
